Summarise in two sentences: The Rayleigh scattering of sunlight by air molecules is stronger at shorter wavelengths. Blue light scatters roughly ten times more than red. At sunset, light travels a longer path through the atmosphere, so most of the blue is scattered away before it reaches the eye, leaving the reds and oranges.

Summarise in two sentences: A write-ahead log records each change before it is applied to the main data files. On restart after a crash, the system replays the log to bring the data files to a consistent state. The cost is an extra sequential write per transaction; the benefit is durability without flushing every random page.

Summarise in one sentence: The Treaty of Westphalia in 1648 ended the Thirty Years' War. It is often cited as the origin of the modern idea of state sovereignty, though historians dispute how sharp the break really was.

Summarise for a non-technical reader, in three sentences: A content delivery network places copies of static files on servers spread around the world. When a user requests a file, they are routed to the nearest copy instead of the origin server. This cuts latency and shields the origin from load spikes, but it introduces a cache invalidation problem when files change.

Summarise the argument in two sentences: Critics of remote work argue that unplanned hallway conversations generate a disproportionate share of new ideas, and that video calls cannot reproduce them. Defenders reply that the same conversations exclude anyone not physically present, and that written asynchronous discussion is more inclusive and leaves a searchable record.

Summarise in two sentences: Antibiotic resistance spreads when bacteria that survive a course of treatment pass their resistance genes on, sometimes across species via plasmids. Incomplete courses and agricultural use both accelerate this, which is why new antibiotics are held in reserve.

Summarise in one sentence: A B-tree keeps its keys sorted and its height low by allowing many children per node, which suits storage where reading one large block costs about the same as reading a small one.

Condense to a single sentence: The company reported revenue up 12% year over year, driven mainly by its subscription tier, while hardware sales fell 4%. Operating margin improved by two points, and management attributed this to lower support costs after the self-service portal launched.

Summarise in two sentences: Rust's borrow checker enforces at compile time that a value has either one mutable reference or any number of immutable ones. This eliminates data races and use-after-free without a garbage collector, at the cost of a steeper learning curve and occasional fights with the compiler over patterns that are safe but hard to prove safe.

Summarise for an executive, in two sentences: The migration is behind schedule because the legacy system's date handling assumed a single timezone. Fixing it requires backfilling nine years of records, which the team estimates at six weeks. Skipping the backfill would leave historical reports subtly wrong.

Summarise in three sentences: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy stored as glucose. The light-dependent reactions in the thylakoid membrane split water and produce ATP and NADPH. The Calvin cycle then uses those to fix carbon dioxide into sugar.
Summarise in one sentence: Eventual consistency means that if no new updates are made, all replicas will converge on the same value, but a read immediately after a write may return a stale result.

Summarise the tradeoff in two sentences: Denormalising a schema duplicates data across tables so that common queries need fewer joins. Reads get faster and simpler, but every write now has to update several places, and the database can no longer enforce that they agree.

Summarise in two sentences: The Apollo guidance computer had about 2 kilobytes of RAM and 36 kilobytes of rope memory. Its software was written by a team at MIT and included a priority scheduler that shed low-priority tasks under overload, which is what saved the Apollo 11 landing when the rendezvous radar flooded it with interrupts.

Summarise in two sentences: A/B tests need enough samples to detect the effect size you care about, and stopping early when the result looks good inflates the false positive rate. Sequential testing methods exist precisely to allow early stopping without that inflation.

Summarise in one sentence: The paper argues that large language model routing can preserve most of the quality of a strong model at a fraction of the cost, provided the router can estimate query difficulty reliably.
